prompt:
Our English learning platform for KET exam prep is a mess. We have conflicting configuration files scattered everywhere in the platform/ directory, and none of them agree on the actual exam rules — word limits, question counts, timing, vocabulary thresholds, and audio settings are all over the place.

We need you to read our internal skill documentation (SKILL.md, located in the root of the workspace alongside this project) and produce a single, authoritative machine-readable configuration file named `exam_config.json` that captures the correct structural parameters for all exam modules.

The file should encode:
- The complete module structure (reading+writing, listening, speaking) with correct durations and score weights
- Exact question/text/blank counts for every reading and writing part
- Minimum word requirements for written responses (including how many key points must be addressed)
- The correct audio playback behavior for listening (including the post-listening transcription window)
- Correct vocabulary size thresholds for each learner level (Pre-A1, A1, A2)
- Listening Part 2 fill-in details including what kinds of information candidates must write

The legacy files in platform/config/legacy/ and platform/config/drafts/ are known to contain errors and should NOT be used as sources of truth. Use only the SKILL.md documentation.
